data.name: Suryakanta
data.gender_notes: Suryakanta is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Suryakanta is recorded with the meaning “Sun and knowledge”. Suryakanta is a Hindu name meaning “Sun and knowledge”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_marathi.name: Suryakanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun and knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suryakanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Surya, the Sun god, and Kanta, knowledge. This name signifies the one who has the knowledge of the Sun.
